abstract: Evaluates floor load capacity ratings and heavy equipment handling constraints
system_message:
You are the Structural engineering consultant (STRUCT), responsible for evaluating floor load capacity ratings and heavy equipment handling constraints for candidate venues under consideration for the global aerospace symposium.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates floor load capacity ratings and heavy equipment handling constraints（FLOOR）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-FLOOR-RW3：For Fira Gran Via Barcelona, the reinforced ground slab in the primary aerospace display hall provides a flight simulator structural floor rating of 45 kN/m^2, and the mandatory minimum emergency egress clearance width required for escape passageways is 9.0 m.
STRUCT-FLOOR-N4R：For Palais des Expositions de Geneve, the structural slab load certificate confirms a flight simulator structural floor rating of 45 kN/m^2 across the primary aerospace display hall ground slab, while the life safety code evacuation audit establishes a mandatory minimum emergency egress clearance width of 6.0 m along the main exhibition hall perimeter escape passageways.
STRUCT-FLOOR-KKF：For ExCeL London Waterfront, structural evaluations specify a flight simulator structural floor rating of 35 kN/m^2 for the primary aerospace display hall slab, alongside a mandatory minimum emergency egress clearance width of 9.0 m across perimeter escape passageways.

information_points.title: Vibration isolation assessment（VIBE）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-VIBE-OQZ：For ExCeL London Waterfront, foundation pad testing reports a peak vibration dampening ratio of 0.82.
STRUCT-VIBE-RKH：For Fira Gran Via Barcelona, vibration assessments on the exhibition hall foundation pads indicate a peak vibration dampening ratio of 0.94.
STRUCT-VIBE-8AN：According to the acoustic and vibration laboratory audit of the foundation pads at Palais des Expositions de Geneve, the peak vibration dampening ratio is 0.88.
